mapper.sql: p.id, p.family_id, p.name, p.gender, p.birth_date, p.death_date, p.birth_place, p.biography, p.photo, p.father_id, p.mother_id, p.adoptive_father_id, p.adoptive_mother_id, p.generation_no, p.order_num, p.status, p.create_time, p.update_time, f.name AS family_name, father.name AS father_name, mother.name AS mother_name
mapper.select: SELECT FROM person p INNER JOIN family f ON f.id = p.family_id LEFT JOIN person father ON father.id = p.father_id LEFT JOIN person mother ON mother.id = p.mother_id WHERE p.id = #{id}

SELECT FROM person p INNER JOIN family f ON f.id = p.family_id LEFT JOIN person father ON father.id = p.father_id LEFT JOIN person mother ON mother.id = p.mother_id WHERE p.family_id = #{familyId} ORDER BY p.generation_no ASC, p.order_num ASC, p.id ASC

SELECT FROM person p INNER JOIN family f ON f.id = p.family_id LEFT JOIN person father ON father.id = p.father_id LEFT JOIN person mother ON mother.id = p.mother_id
AND p.family_id = #{familyId}
AND (p.name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR IFNULL(father.name, '') LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR IFNULL(mother.name, '') LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR IFNULL(p.birth_place, '') LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%'))
ORDER BY p.generation_no ASC, p.order_num ASC, p.id ASC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO person (family_id, name, gender, birth_date, death_date, birth_place, biography, photo, father_id, mother_id, adoptive_father_id, adoptive_mother_id, generation_no, order_num, status) VALUES (#{familyId}, #{name}, #{gender}, #{birthDate}, #{deathDate}, #{birthPlace}, #{biography}, #{photo}, #{fatherId}, #{motherId}, #{adoptiveFatherId}, #{adoptiveMotherId}, #{generationNo}, #{orderNum}, #{status})
mapper.update: UPDATE person SET family_id = #{familyId}, name = #{name}, gender = #{gender}, birth_date = #{birthDate}, death_date = #{deathDate}, birth_place = #{birthPlace}, biography = #{biography}, photo = #{photo}, father_id = #{fatherId}, mother_id = #{motherId}, adoptive_father_id = #{adoptiveFatherId}, adoptive_mother_id = #{adoptiveMotherId}, generation_no = #{generationNo}, order_num = #{orderNum}, status = #{status} WHERE id = #{id}

SELECT p.name FROM marriage m INNER JOIN person p ON p.id = CASE WHEN m.husband_id = #{id} THEN m.wife_id ELSE m.husband_id END WHERE m.husband_id = #{id} OR m.wife_id = #{id}

SELECT FROM person p INNER JOIN family f ON f.id = p.family_id LEFT JOIN person father ON father.id = p.father_id LEFT JOIN person mother ON mother.id = p.mother_id WHERE p.father_id = #{parentId} OR p.mother_id = #{parentId} ORDER BY p.order_num ASC, p.id ASC

SELECT FROM person p INNER JOIN family f ON f.id = p.family_id LEFT JOIN person father ON father.id = p.father_id LEFT JOIN person mother ON mother.id = p.mother_id WHERE p.family_id = #{familyId} AND p.father_id IS NULL AND p.mother_id IS NULL ORDER BY p.generation_no ASC, p.order_num ASC, p.id ASC
